name: As You Like It (The Sarasota Players, 97th Season Opener)
venue: The Sarasota Players at The Crossings at Siesta Key
address: 3501 S Tamiami Trail, Suite 1130, Sarasota, FL 34239
hours_label: Evenings 7:30 PM, matinees 2 PM · Tickets via box office
blurb: The Sarasota Players, the area's oldest theatre company, opens its 97th season with Shakespeare's pastoral comedy of disguise and romance in the Forest of Arden. Live musicians underscore the scenes with original music written for the production. Performances at the company's home in The Crossings at Siesta Key; park and enter by Connors Steak & Seafood. Tickets through the box office (941-365-2494).

name: Sarasota Opera Food & Wine Festival
hours_label: Doors 1 PM (VIP 12:30 PM) · $75 advance / $85 door, VIP $150
blurb: Formerly Taste of Downtown, this afternoon tasting inside the historic Sarasota Opera House brings together restaurants from across Sarasota and Manatee with wine pours and live performances by the Sarasota Youth Opera. Proceeds support the youth opera program, one of the nation's top young-singer training programs. $75 in advance, $85 at the door; VIP $150 with 12:30 PM early entry.

name: Van Wezel Family Fest
venue: Van Wezel Performing Arts Hall (back lawn & Grand Foyer)
blurb: The Van Wezel's free back-to-school celebration on the bayfront lawn: food trucks, games, a photo booth, literacy activities and a Kids Market run by young local entrepreneurs. Asolo Rep on Tour performs two sensory-friendly shows of Beanstalk: The Adventures of Jack and the Giant at 10 AM and 1 PM, with FST Improv leading family games at 11:30 AM. Free admission for all ages.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
hours_label: About 1 hour before sunset (~6:45 PM) · Free
blurb: A Siesta Key tradition for decades: drummers, dancers and onlookers gather on the powder-white sand every Sunday evening to play the sun down over the Gulf. Bring a chair or a drum and join in; it is free and all ages are welcome. Arrive early, as Siesta Beach parking fills on weekend evenings.
